provenance.source_title: Your Life After Marrying Into Royalty

examples.psychological_goal: 用两个物件细节写尽人物的经济层
examples.expression_mechanism: 贫困指纹（必坏的暖气+磨破的袖口）
examples.example_text: The heater breaks every single winter. Your one good jacket is fraying at the cuffs.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用「年年如此的小破损」代替收入数字写窘迫
examples.negative_instruction: 细节必须是长期习惯了的破损，不可写成突发事故

examples.psychological_goal: 用一个小动作埋下她的善意密码
examples.expression_mechanism: 延迟解码（一样的小杯茶→还不懂的善意）
examples.example_text: She orders the same small tea you do. You do not understand that kindness yet.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习先写动作再标注「你以后才懂」，让温柔悬空发酵
examples.negative_instruction: 不可当场解释善意，解码必须留给以后

examples.psychological_goal: 用画面三拍揭开她的隐藏世界
examples.expression_mechanism: 画面三拍（黑车/大汉/士兵式点头）
examples.example_text: A black car waits at the corner. Two large men stand beside it. They nod to her like soldiers.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习不给答案先给三个异常画面，让读者自己拉警报
examples.negative_instruction: 画面必须具体且逐拍升级，不可直接说「她很有来头」

examples.psychological_goal: 用笑的错位写真相的重量
examples.expression_mechanism: 笑的错位（你当玩笑，她不笑）
examples.example_text: Her father is a king. You laugh because it must be a joke. She does not laugh at all.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用一方笑一方不笑的错位，让荒诞答案落地为真
examples.negative_instruction: 真相必须短句直给，不可加修饰词缓冲

examples.psychological_goal: 用一件信物把幻想切换成征召
examples.expression_mechanism: 信物转场（王室火漆信→被召见）
examples.example_text: Then a letter arrives with a royal seal. You are summoned to the palace.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用一件带权威印记的物件做段落切换，被动语态交出主动权
examples.negative_instruction: 转场物件必须自带权力符号（火漆/印章），不可用普通通知

examples.psychological_goal: 用否定句升级量级
examples.expression_mechanism: 否定升级（不是房子，是要塞）
examples.example_text: The building is not a house. It is a fortress with towers and a name.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用「不是X，是Y」把日常名词升级为权力名词
examples.negative_instruction: Y必须带具体特征（塔楼/名字），不可只写「很大」

examples.psychological_goal: 用不退缩的平静写出人物脊梁
examples.expression_mechanism: 平静陈述+不退缩标记（修了三十年水管）
examples.example_text: Your father fixed pipes for 30 years. You say it plainly and you do not flinch.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习让人物用平实的陈述通过尊严考验
examples.negative_instruction: 尊严必须靠陈述语气体现，不可让角色发表自尊演说

examples.psychological_goal: 用夸张数量证明爱的纯度
examples.expression_mechanism: 数量化献身（愿意签一百页）
examples.example_text: You would have signed a hundred pages to keep her.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用「愿意做X的一百倍」证明动机与条款无关
examples.negative_instruction: 夸张必须落在动作上（签），不可落在形容词上

examples.psychological_goal: 一句话拆穿公众欢呼的对象
examples.expression_mechanism: 对象纠偏（欢呼的是故事，不是你）
examples.example_text: They cheer a man they have never met. They cheer the story, not you.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用「他们欢呼X不是你」把盛大场面翻成孤独现场
examples.negative_instruction: 纠偏必须在场面最盛时给出，不可提前铺垫

examples.psychological_goal: 一句话定义「家人名义下的受审感」
examples.expression_mechanism: 错置比喻（晚饭=没备考的考试）
examples.example_text: Every dinner is an exam you never studied for.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习把日常场景重命名为一场没给 syllabus 的考核
examples.negative_instruction: 比喻两端必须是高频日常（晚饭/考试），不可生僻

examples.psychological_goal: 用最小单位给进展定价
examples.expression_mechanism: 最小单位判词（一寸就是一切）
examples.example_text: You earn 1 inch of his trust. An inch is everything.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习把巨大进展换算成最小单位，反而放大其重量
examples.negative_instruction: 单位必须与上下文尺度呼应，不可随口取量词

examples.psychological_goal: 让保护欲的半径越过阵营边界
examples.expression_mechanism: 保护清单的越界项（包括这个家族）
examples.example_text: You will protect him from this family if you must.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习在誓言清单末尾加一个「不该出现」的对象制造张力
examples.negative_instruction: 越界项必须与人物所处阵营一致，不可为反转而反转

examples.psychological_goal: 用「区分」句给人物策略定性
examples.expression_mechanism: 用法区分定成败（只用来保护）
examples.example_text: You use it only to protect the family. That single distinction earns you everything.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习同一种资源两种用法，把成败归因到用法之别
examples.negative_instruction: 必须先建立资源（知识/秘密），再谈用法区分

examples.psychological_goal: 用镜像句写出权力的双面账
examples.expression_mechanism: 镜像对账（更必要/更孤独）
examples.example_text: Each secret you bury makes you more necessary. Each secret you bury also makes you more alone.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用同因双果的镜像句，一句话记完权力的收入与成本
examples.negative_instruction: 两个结果必须一正一负且同时成立，不可只写代价

examples.psychological_goal: 用缺席者写出阶层的墙
examples.expression_mechanism: 缺席即证词（没人来水管工的葬礼）
examples.example_text: No royalty came to a plumber's funeral. That absence told you everything about loyalty.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用「谁没来」+「缺席告诉了你一切」让空白自己下判词
examples.negative_instruction: 判词必须止于「忠诚」一词，不可展开感慨

examples.psychological_goal: 把怜悯重定义为权力的奢侈品
examples.expression_mechanism: 价值重排（怜悯=权力才负担得起的奢侈）
examples.example_text: That mercy is not weakness. It is the one luxury real power can afford.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习先否定一个误读（软弱），再给出翻转的奢侈品定义
examples.negative_instruction: 奢侈品定义必须与全片财富语境呼应，不可泛化为鸡汤

examples.psychological_goal: 用同一词的正反写传承悖论
examples.expression_mechanism: 同词对仗（血建起它，血撑不住它）
examples.example_text: blood built this crown, but blood will not keep it standing.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用同一个词承担建与毁两个角色，一句话写完传承悖论
examples.negative_instruction: 对仗两半必须分别被前文证据支撑（王朝史/继承人失败）

examples.psychological_goal: 用否定宏大来回扣最初的小
examples.expression_mechanism: 王座/女孩对置（从未想要王座，只要课堂上的女孩）
examples.example_text: You never wanted a throne. You only wanted that girl from the language class.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习在权力顶点用「只想要最初的小东西」完成人物收束
examples.negative_instruction: 最初的小东西必须是开场建立过的意象，不可临时造

examples.psychological_goal: 用双重否定完成主题降级
examples.expression_mechanism: 降级重锤×2（钱/王冠都不是重点）
examples.example_text: The money was never the point. The crown was never the point. That was the secret the whole time.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习用同构否定句连击两层宏大，再用「秘密」一词收束
examples.negative_instruction: 两层否定必须对应全片两个最大的意象，不可泛化

examples.psychological_goal: 用场景复制把结局接回开头
examples.expression_mechanism: 循环回收（另一个年轻人+咖啡馆+还未知的姓）
examples.example_text: Somewhere out there, a young man is sitting across from a woman in a quiet cafe. He does not know her last name yet.
examples.usage_instruction: 学习把开场场景复制给一个新人物，让个案变成循环警示
examples.negative_instruction: 复制元素必须与开场一一对应（咖啡馆/姓氏），不可只写「还有别人」
